_comment: M42/T42.5 (R18-F2, docs/plan-drive-identity.md §2.4): what scripts/drive/run.py must discover under widgets/ before it opens any window.
Edited by hand, never generated from the inventories: a manifest read from what it checks is the tautology this replaces.
A removal fails; an addition fails until this file names it, so the change is visible in the diff.
`static` lists every action that is not checked for landing; `counts` pins actions, landed-checked (non-static) and isolated (T42.6).

PickList: releasing over a row chooses it
a picklist does not filter on its trigger
Combobox: clearing the query shows everything again
Menu: it shows its commands with no trigger
Pagination: the next arrow steps one page
pressing a number goes to that page
the keyboard jumps to the last page
a number is the page it shows, not its position in the strip
the previous arrow steps back, it does not jump
Tree: pressing a parent folds its whole subtree away
pressing a leaf reports nothing, because nothing happened
a hover lights the row under the pointer
DataGrid: it shows its columns over virtualized rows
a wheel scrolls the rows under the header
NumberInput: ArrowUp steps it up by exactly one step
RangeSlider: a press takes the nearer handle and moves it
a handle driven past the other stops at it
SearchField: a click reaches the text, not the container
the magnifier is left of the text and inside the pill
Wrap: six chips land on more than one line
every child is inside the container it reported
Grid: six badges land on exactly two rows of three
SplitPane: it stops short of the edge
Accordion: a press on the header opens the section
a press on the header again closes it
PaneGrid: a column's divider moves only that column
a drag keeps the divider it started on
Tabs: a press selects the item under it
a press on the item already selected changes nothing but is taken
BottomNav: a press selects the item under it
a press on the item already selected changes nothing but is taken
NavigationRail: a press selects the item under it
a press on the item already selected changes nothing but is taken
AppBar: it shows its title and does not grow with it
PullToRefresh: a downward drag pulls the content
an upward wheel is not a pull
ColorPicker: a cell sets the value and closes the popup
a press outside closes it and changes nothing
DatePicker: a cell sets the value and closes the popup
a press outside closes it and changes nothing
the arrows page the month and keep the day
TimePicker: a cell sets the value and closes the popup
a press outside closes it and changes nothing
a minute mark changes the minute and not the hour
FilePicker: a cell sets the value and closes the popup
a press outside closes it and changes nothing
RichText: it publishes what a reader sees, and wraps to fit
Markdown: the markers are markup, not text
RichTextEditor: typing markup updates the preview under it
PaintBox: the application's drawing is on screen and inside the box
Card: a button on the card reaches the application
the content is inset by the card's padding
Toast: it shrinks to its text rather than filling the stage
it paints a ground, so its light text is readable
Tooltip: hovering the content opens the tip
the tip does not take the pointer from its content
TextInput: backspace removes the character before the caret
TextArea: a paste keeps its line breaks, as one edit
Slider: a click sets the value to where it landed
End takes it to the maximum
Home takes it to the minimum
an arrow moves it by one step, not to an end
Button: a held press shows on the button
hovering is visible and is not a press
CheckBox: a click flips the bound flag
a second click flips it back
the second checkbox is independently addressable
Switch: a click flips the bound flag
the track changes colour with the state
Radio: clicking the other option moves the selection
Modal: a press on the scrim asks to dismiss
the control on the panel still reaches the application
Sheet: a press on the scrim asks to dismiss
the control on the panel still reaches the application
Drawer: a press on the scrim asks to dismiss
the control on the panel still reaches the application
